# SalaryBox

> > SalaryBox is India's leading provider of biometric attendance machines and payroll software solutions, featuring AI-powered face recognition technology.

SalaryBox offers advanced workforce management solutions including the FaceScan Pro and Gamma biometric devices with WiFi and LAN connectivity. The platform combines hardware attendance tracking with integrated payroll and employee management software for businesses across India.
